func:
// GlobalStateReader: returns a complete UI snapshot after reread.
if (msg.topic !== 'reread') return null;

var settings = global.get('settings') || {};
var driveState = global.get('drive_state') || global.get('elmo') || {};

function normalizeLanguage(value) {
    var text = String(value || '').toLowerCase();
    return (text === 'english' || text === 'en') ? 'english' : 'russian';
}
function valueOr(value, fallback) {
    return value !== undefined && value !== null ? value : fallback;
}

var language = normalizeLanguage(
    (settings.general && settings.general.language) ||
    global.get('ui_language') ||
    'russian'
);
var driveLimits = driveState.drive_limits || global.get('drive_limits') || global.get('drive_limits_override') || null;
var resolution = driveState.resolution || (driveLimits && driveLimits.resolution) || global.get('current_range') || 'high';
var recordingDuration = valueOr(global.get('recording_duration_sec'), settings.advanced && settings.advanced.dataDurationSec);
recordingDuration = Number(recordingDuration) || 60;
var scenarioFiles = (global.get('scenario_files') && global.get('scenario_files').length)
    ? global.get('scenario_files')
    : ['high_resolution.scn', 'low_resolution.scn', 'range_switch.scn'];
var scenarioDocuments = global.get('scenario_documents') || {};
var scenarioState = global.get('scenario_state') || { enabled:false, status:'idle', file_name:'', file_path:'', step_index:0, step_count:0, target_speed_deg_per_sec:0, target_speed_ticks:0, current_speed_deg_per_sec:0, ready:false, ready_error_percent:null, hold_started_at:0, hold_ends_at:0, hold_remaining_sec:0, last_error:'', save_raw_data:false };

var elmo = {
    position: valueOr(driveState.position, 0),
    velocity: valueOr(driveState.velocity, 0),
    velocity_raw: valueOr(driveState.velocity_raw, driveState.velocity),
    velocity_derived: valueOr(driveState.velocity_derived, null),
    velocity_source: valueOr(driveState.velocity_source, 'vx'),
    velocity_deg_per_sec: valueOr(driveState.velocity_deg_per_sec, null),
    torque: valueOr(driveState.torque, 0),
    so: valueOr(driveState.so, false),
    mo: valueOr(driveState.mo, false),
    ms: valueOr(driveState.ms, 3),
    af: valueOr(driveState.af, 0),
    sp: valueOr(driveState.sp, 0),
    ac: valueOr(driveState.ac, 0),
    dc: valueOr(driveState.dc, 0),
    jv: valueOr(driveState.jv, 0),
    jp: valueOr(driveState.jp, 0),
    tr1: valueOr(driveState.tr1, 0),
    tr3: valueOr(driveState.tr3, 0),
    sd: valueOr(driveState.sd, 0),
    qs: valueOr(driveState.qs, 0),
    vh1: valueOr(driveState.vh1, 0),
    vl1: valueOr(driveState.vl1, 0),
    vh2: valueOr(driveState.vh2, 0),
    sr: valueOr(driveState.sr, 0),
    tm_us: valueOr(driveState.tm_us, global.get('elmo_tm_us')),
    sr_status: driveState.sr_status || {
        raw: 0,
        binary: '00000000000000000000000000000000',
        amplifier_bits_0_3: '0000',
        amplifier_code: 0,
        amplifier_text: '\u041e\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043e\u043a \u043d\u0435\u0442',
        ok: true,
        errors: [],
        summary: '\u041e\u0448\u0438\u0431\u043e\u043a \u043d\u0435\u0442'
    },
    resolution: resolution,
    drive_limits: driveLimits
};

var initPayload = {
    language: language,
    settings: settings,
    elmo: elmo,
    position: elmo.position,
    velocity: elmo.velocity,
    velocity_raw: elmo.velocity_raw,
    velocity_derived: elmo.velocity_derived,
    velocity_source: elmo.velocity_source,
    velocity_deg_per_sec: elmo.velocity_deg_per_sec,
    torque: elmo.torque,
    so: elmo.so,
    mo: elmo.mo,
    ms: elmo.ms,
    af: elmo.af,
    sp: elmo.sp,
    ac: elmo.ac,
    dc: elmo.dc,
    jv: elmo.jv,
    jp: elmo.jp,
    tr1: elmo.tr1,
    tr3: elmo.tr3,
    sd: elmo.sd,
    qs: elmo.qs,
    vh1: elmo.vh1,
    vl1: elmo.vl1,
    vh2: elmo.vh2,
    sr: elmo.sr,
    tm_us: elmo.tm_us,
    sr_status: elmo.sr_status,
    resolution: resolution,
    drive_limits: driveLimits,
    protocol_open: !!global.get('protocol_open'),
    protocol_file: global.get('protocol_filename') || '',
    is_recording: !!global.get('is_recording'),
    recording_duration_sec: recordingDuration,
    recording_ends_at: Number(global.get('recording_ends_at')) || 0,
    is_recording_raw: !!global.get('is_recording_raw'),
    recording_save_raw_data: !!global.get('recording_save_raw_data'),
    scenario_state: scenarioState,
    scenario_files: scenarioFiles,
    scenario_documents: scenarioDocuments,
    bun_angle: global.get('bun_angle') || 0,
    bun_brake: valueOr(global.get('bun_brake'), false),
    logs: global.get('logs') || []
};

return { topic: 'init', language: language, settings: settings, payload: initPayload };
